steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates described Barbie as an iconic toy, citing over a billion dolls sold by 2006 and claims of three sold every second. It said Barbie accounted for about 27% of Mattel’s business in 2022 and brought in over $1 billion a year.

episode.title: Barbie may be pink, but Mattel is seeing red

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates reported Mattel launched an NFT marketplace on Flow to turn Hot Wheels and Barbie into digital collectables, expanding how fans could engage with its brands.

episode.title: 59 - Genesis fallout, CZ & the Coinbase tweet storm & JP Morgan's Digital Wallet plans

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates outlined intense competition for Barbie from Bratz, media giants and YouTubers, and noted Mattel’s unprofitable years in 2017, 2018 and 2019 before a new CEO pivoted the strategy toward Hollywood.

episode.title: Barbie may be pink, but Mattel is seeing red

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates explained a new CEO revived Mattel Films and put Hollywood at the centre of strategy, seeking to monetise toy IP through movies to drive a turnaround.

episode.title: Barbie may be pink, but Mattel is seeing red
